components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Pill button with the primary fill; renders as a link or a button. Hover dims, press scales to 0.98.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:0.5rem;font-family:'DM Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;font-size:1rem;font-weight:500;line-height:1.5;text-decoration:none;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid transparent;padding:0.75rem 1.5rem;cursor:pointer;transition:opacity 0.15s ease,background-color 0.15s ease,transform 0.15s ease;background:#00301c;color:#f4ece6}.ds-btn-primary:hover{opacity:0.9}.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #00301c;outline-offset:2px}.ds-btn-primary:active:not(:disabled){transform:scale(0.98)}.ds-btn-primary:disabled{opacity:0.5;cursor:not-allowed}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-btn-primary{transition:opacity 0.15s ease,background-color 0.15s ease}.ds-btn-primary:active:not(:disabled){transform:none}}

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Transparent pill with a hairline border; hover adds a primary tint instead of dimming.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:0.5rem;font-family:'DM Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;font-size:1rem;font-weight:500;line-height:1.5;text-decoration:none;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid transparent;padding:0.75rem 1.5rem;cursor:pointer;transition:opacity 0.15s ease,background-color 0.15s ease,transform 0.15s ease;background:transparent;color:#14201a;border-color:#ded3c9}.ds-btn-secondary:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,#00301c 8%,transparent)}.ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #00301c;outline-offset:2px}.ds-btn-secondary:active:not(:disabled){transform:scale(0.98)}.ds-btn-secondary:disabled{opacity:0.5;cursor:not-allowed}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-btn-secondary{transition:opacity 0.15s ease,background-color 0.15s ease}.ds-btn-secondary:active:not(:disabled){transform:none}}

components.name: Field
components.description: Label wrapping a 3rem-tall input, with an optional error line announced via role alert.

components.css: .ds-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0.25rem}.ds-label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0.25rem;font-family:'DM Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;font-size:0.875rem;color:#6b6259}.ds-input{font-family:'DM Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;font-size:1rem;color:#14201a;background:#ffffff;border:1px solid #ded3c9;border-radius:0.75rem;padding:0.75rem 1rem;width:100%;min-height:3rem}.ds-input:focus-visible{border-color:#00301c;outline:2px solid #00301c;outline-offset:1px}.ds-error{font-family:'DM Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;color:#7a1f0e;font-size:0.875rem}

components.name: Card
components.description: Surface container with a hairline border; no shadow. Full width with an optional max width.

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Pill track of radio options for the theme choice; the selected pill is filled with primary.
components.css: .ds-track{display:flex;gap:0.25rem;padding:0.25rem;background:#f4ece6;border:1px solid #ded3c9;border-radius:999px}.ds-option{position:relative;flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:row;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:2.75rem;border-radius:999px;font-family:'DM Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;font-size:1rem;font-weight:500;color:#14201a;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 0.15s ease,color 0.15s ease}.ds-option input{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;margin:0;padding:0;opacity:0;cursor:pointer}.ds-option:has(input:checked){background:#00301c;color:#f4ece6}.ds-option:has(input:focus-visible){outline:2px solid #00301c;outline-offset:2px}

components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-around;gap:0;background:#ffffff;border-top:1px solid #ded3c9;padding:0.5rem 0}.ds-nav-item{flex:1 1 0;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:0.25rem;font-family:'DM Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;font-size:0.75rem;color:#6b6259;text-decoration:none;padding:0.25rem 0;white-space:nowrap;border-radius:999px;transition:color 0.15s ease,background-color 0.15s ease,transform 0.15s ease}.ds-nav-item:hover{color:#14201a}.ds-nav-item[aria-current='page']{color:#00301c;background:color-mix(in srgb,#00301c 10%,transparent)}.ds-nav-item:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #00301c;outline-offset:2px}.ds-nav-item:active{transform:scale(0.96)}@media (max-width:22rem){.ds-nav-item{font-size:0.6875rem}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-nav-item{transition:color 0.15s ease,background-color 0.15s ease}.ds-nav-item:active{transform:none}}

narrative.overview:
Gastar is a calm, precise, personal book of accounts. Numbers lead, and the accent appears only at moments that matter. The tone is the classic, serious-bank feel from PRODUCT.md, a durable brand commitment rather than a style option. Light and dark themes are both first-class.

The system is quiet and flat. Tonal layering and hairline borders carry structure, type weight carries hierarchy, and a single lifted element marks the primary action. Buttons and navigation are tactile and confident: pill shapes, a firm 2px focus ring, a slight press scale, and a clear dimmed disabled state.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, paper-like light theme and a deep forest-green dark theme, switched by token swap only.
One typeface (DM Sans) with weight, not size, doing most of the hierarchy work.
Flat surfaces separated by hairline borders; one shadow in the whole app.

rules.name: The Signal Lime Rule
rules.body: Signal Lime is a fill and outline color only in dark. On Warm Paper it is illegible as text, so never use it for text in the light theme.

rules.name: The Token Rule
rules.body: Colors come from the theme tokens; never hardcode a hex in a component.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every money amount uses `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` (the `.amount` class) so columns align.

rules.name: The One Lift Rule
rules.body: Only the FAB is lifted. Everything else stays flat with a hairline border.

dos: **Do** use the theme tokens for every color, radius and spacing value.
**Do** put `tabular-nums` on every amount; income uses `positive` and outcome uses `negative`.
**Do** use pill buttons and the 0.75rem radius for fields and cards.
**Do** keep the FAB as the single lifted element; everything else is flat with a hairline border.
**Do** keep Signal Lime as a fill or outline in dark only.
donts: **Don't** use Signal Lime as text on Warm Paper; it is illegible there.
**Don't** add new shadows, or hover, press and disabled treatments beyond those described in Components (0.9 hover opacity, tints, press scale, 0.5 disabled).

**Don't** treat these known gaps (documented, not decided) as settled: there is no transfer color token, the FAB shadow is hardcoded black, z-indices are not tokenized, and the tint percentages (8% and 10% `color-mix`) and the 0.96 and 0.98 press scales are repeated literals rather than tokens.
